chapter: New York, Philadelphia and Harlem nightlife
title: Leap-frogging into the limelight with Decca
summary: He describes the thrill of records bearing his name, and the self-doubt left by his early teacher.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So, that's where we stand on moving around from town to town. For example, New York. When I got to New York it was like...shortly after I was here, you know, I met Mayo Williams and I did that Cow Cow Davenport thing, so it wasn't a question of money, 'cause I was making some money. Then all of a sudden you find yourself leap-frogging into the limelight, and records coming out with your name on it, something that you never thought would ever happen. And once you think that you can play, or you know you can play, but because of something somebody said to you, make you a little apprehensive. Well, that was the thing that I had to overcome.
